android.desc:
ZA Bank is a regulated and licensed Hong Kong bank and the first digital bank to launch in Hong Kong. It offers services and features like deposits, ZA Card, loans, foreign currency exchange, local and overseas transfers, insurance and more in one app. In addition, ZA Bank also offers an award-winning Business Internet Banking platform!

Experience the difference: 

ZA Card – The first Visa debit card with your own number in Hong Kong
Get the first Visa debit card with a customisable card number in Hong Kong! You can even apply for a physical card! To protect you from the risk of theft, the physical ZA Card does not have a CVV or expiration date.

Open a ZA Bank account in as fast as 2 minutes**, even if you’re on holiday! Enjoy 24 x 7, full-featured digital banking services.

Visit bank.za.group to learn more about our products and services.
*The time required to open an account depends on the actual circumstances. In general, users can open an account in as fast as 2 minutes, without submitting any additional information.

To enhance your user experience, when you join our marketing campaigns, games, or use interactive features in the ZA Bank App, we may collect your step count data from your device. 

On iOS, after you log in and grant authorisation, your step count will be synced from Apple Health (HealthKit). This data may come from your iPhone, Apple Watch, compatible wearables, or apps connected to Apple Health. On Android, after you log in and grant authorisation, your step count will be synced from your chosen app (e.g. Health Connect). You can connect your wearable/fitness device to that app for syncing. 
 
Minimum permissions and user control: We request read-only access to your step count data and will not collect other data, e.g. heart rate, sleep data, or location. You can revoke or adjust permissions at any time via your device settings/health platforms, and disable related features in the ZA Bank App. If your permission is not granted or later revoked, your step count will no longer be synced. Some interactive features may be limited as a result, but this won't affect your use of ZA Bank's core banking functions. We only use step count data for the interactive features described above, and not for personalised ads. We use industry-standard security measures to protect this data. View our Privacy Policy for details.

quotes.text:
Mcdonald's HK App should have lots of people talking about it in HK, but I have never heard anyone mentioning about Mcdonald's App. As there are 1 Million downloads shown on the play store statistics and as there are around 8 Million people in Hong Kong, it means there are 1 out of 8 people downloading Mcdonald's HK app (excluding iOS). And given the assumptions suggested from Statista [3], HK has 91% smart phone market penetration rate, and iOS:Android ratio should be around 4:6 (which should be 7:3 from my personal experience). It could mean that 1 out of 4 people in HK will have this app downloaded, either on iOS or Android, but I haven't heard from any of my network even mentioning this app. (Note: This app is meant for localization as its main feature is for local delivery + the name of the app itself)

A usual case for half of your friends to mention the app can already be achieved when there is around 100K - 500K Android Downloads. Two good examples are ZA Bank[4] & LIHKG[5], ZA Bank has only 100K+ Downloads on HK Play Store, yet I hear at least 30% of my network talking about it, 70% for LIHKG. This is why I kinda conclude that Mcdonald's Hong Kong has bought certain amount of downloads.

Adding on to this, when I'm checking the reviews on play store, I see that 80% of the 1-2 stars reviewers are local and more than 90% the 5 stars reviewers are non-local, concluding that they are buying 5 stars review.

It seems like Mcdonald's Hong Kong's company rather spends a …
quotes.story_title: Mcdonald's HK app has 1M+ Downloads, but it's the worst app I have ever seen
